[Shot 1] 10‑second continuous cinematic fantasy shot, 16:9 landscape. The character is within this environment, moves gracefully into upright standing position, faces the camera, and begins speaking.

The camera pushes in with very slow and small amplitude toward her face. Soft cyan‑green light from the upper right fluctuates gently as if refracted through moving water, creating subtle moving highlights across her eyes, cheeks, hair, fingers, and shimmering dress. Fine luminous particles drift slowly through the air; loose hair strands and the translucent fabric move delicately in a faint current, while the glass spheres produce restrained shifting reflections.

She looks directly into the lens and says in natural Mandarin: <d>[Mandarin Chinese]马年吉祥物驾到！这只萌萌哒小马驹，给你带来一整年的好运与陪伴</d>

Use <Audio 1> to match the adult young woman’s voice quality, soft intimate tone, slightly breathy delivery, moderately fast Mandarin speaking rhythm, and expressive intonation. Her lip‑sync must be accurate and synchronized to every syllable.

After she finishes speaking, she fans herself near her face and neck with one hand, clearly showing she feels hot, while looking at the camera with a playful, slightly helpless expression. Her hair and translucent dress flow naturally with the gesture.

Throughout the video, globally reference <Picture 2> to keep the same character identity, hairstyle, eye color, dress, body proportions, and elegant fantasy style. Preserve underwater ambient sound, delicate fabric movement, glass sphere resonance, and subtle ethereal atmosphere. Add light hand‑wind sound and natural clothing movement when she fans herself.

No subtitles, logos, watermarks, or text. Prevent identity drift, facial distortion, lip‑sync delay, extra fingers, wrong hand poses, floating body, clothing deformation, hair color change, eye color change, background warping, and any change to the original dark aquatic fantasy environment.
